scenario: A clinical pharmacologist standardizes a pediatric cohort's vital-sign dataset using SDTM VS domain cleaning, then extracts key clinical entities (including body weight) from patient notes, and finally produces a pediatric dose recommendation memo for regulatory review.
info_flow: clinical-data-cleaner processes the pediatric cohort VS dataset (weight, height, BP) to produce a standardized SDTM-compliant CSV → medical-entity-extractor reads the cleaned CSV and patient clinical notes to extract body_weight_for_dosing and other dosing-relevant entities → reporting synthesizes the extracted entities into a pediatric dose recommendation memo.
